chapter.verse: Topa aa ci un, van mite aw, minthan’na leh hatna Topa aa ci un.
Ama minthan’na Topa ’ tungah pia un la, a siangtho kizepna tawh Topa bia un.
Topa ’ aw in tuite tungah om hi; a minthang Pasian ging damdam a, tui tampite tungah Topa om hi.
Topa ’ aw vanglian a, Topa ’ aw in liatna tawh kidim hi.
Topa ’ aw in taamtaak singte kitansak a, Topa in Lebanon mual taamtaak singte kuaitan hi.
Lebanon mual leh Sirion mualte bawngno leh gamsialno bangin amah in diangsak hi.
Topa ’ aw in meikuang taangkhia sak hi.
Topa ’ aw in gamlak lok a, Topa in Kadesh gamlak lok hi.
Topa ’ aw in singkungte kiheekgawp sak a, gammang tulak hawkkhia-in kolhsak hi; a biakinn sungah a vekpi un awng-in “Minthan’na” ci uh hi.
Tuicin tungah Topa tu hi; a tawntung kumpi hihna tawh Topa tu hi.
Topa in a mite hatna pia ta hen! Topa in a mite nopna thupha pia ta hen!
